description: The proving place: one fixed place holding every case of template 3 (the plateau) of architecture-world-map.md, baked by the real pipeline (buildPlace). Every cliff piece is judged on it, day and night, 1x and 4x. Terrain only: grass everywhere, with raised land (the cliff terrain) in the rectangles below, each [x0, y0, x1, y1] in cells, ends included. The left sample (cols 0 to 17) is panel A of the template; the three blocks on the right (cols 20 to 34) are panel C's steps of 1 and 3 rows beside the sample's step of 2.

cases.label: 6 south face: columns S and corner cells (callout 6)
8 step in the face of 2 rows: E2 (callout 8, panel C k=2)
12 notch in the back: inner corners (callout 12)
13 step of 1 row: E1 (panel C k=1)
14 step of 3 rows: E over the face behind (panel C k=3)
15 long side wall: head, band, tail (panel C k=6)
